promises.said: Require formal legislative or administrative filings on all four citizen complaints above the visibility threshold, with responsible offices, next action dates, and a public closeout index.
Publish the C114 placement-gap analysis and a program adjustment plan, explicitly examining West Oakland and Fruitvale without inventing unreported placement results.
Direct the City Auditor and Economic Development staff to execute a formal commercial corridor viability and housing pressure assessment for Rockridge before any municipal intervention is drafted.

Convene the C114 preliminary schematics community review as set by the council: two bilingual sessions (senior center and library), merchant-covenant compliance dossier and Mayer & Associates' community-oversight record published for scrutiny, a written public comment-and-response record, and no assertion of final design or construction approval.

Advance charter renewal drafting with the Fund's scope explicitly preserved to West Oakland businesses and residents as chartered, and publish the draft language for review alongside the closeout record.

C114 — Mara Vance's directive, written after the close.
Directed Avery Santana — Mayor: Identify the four petition-specific filings and public closeout index, reconcile their coverage with the current complaint ledger, and provide the INIT-007 placement-gap analysis and adjustment plan.
Directed Denise Carter — City Council District 1: Establish the status of Brooklyn’s transformer outage and identify any remaining municipal coordination needed for affected households and businesses.
Directed Leonard Tran — City Council District 2: Clarify INIT-008’s recorded disposition and identify what Downtown transit-access and Uptown planning work can proceed under existing authority.
Directed Rose Delgado — City Council District 3: Reconcile the San Antonio complaint-response record with the corridor plan still described as needed and identify the next district action, if any.
Directed Ramon Vega — City Council District 4: State whether INIT-014’s legislation has been filed and reconcile its docket with the separate INIT-011, INIT-012 and INIT-013 records.
Directed Janae Rivers — City Council District 5: Report what the East Oakland economic spike is affecting and whether existing business or youth-program support needs adjustment.
Directed Warren Ashford — City Council District 7: Confirm that the Rockridge commercial-corridor and housing-pressure assessment has been commissioned and explain how it will reconcile the differing neighborhood signals.
Directed Nina Chen — City Council District 8: Identify the administrative actions and maintenance scheduling arising from the Eastlake review and Adams Point service request without assuming INIT-009 funding is authorized.
Directed Terrence Mobley — City Council District 9: Check whether Laurel’s missed garbage pickup has been resolved and identify any routine service follow-through still needed.
Directed Marcus Webb — OEWD Program Director (Stabilization Fund): Identify the renewal draft available for public review or state precisely what drafting remains before its publication.
Directed Elena Soria Dominguez — Transit Hub Planning Lead: Report which schematics and community-review sessions have actually been delivered and where their covenant, oversight and comment-response records can be read.
Not directing:
- Elliott Crane (City Council District 6): Cycle 114 provides no unresolved district event or dated step requiring direction; the reported community milestone does not itself call for intervention.
- Vanessa Tran-Muñoz (OARI Program Director): Her Cycle 114 statement reports the briefing held and D1 and D5 evaluations filed, with Baylight work limited to feasibility review; the tracker’s next step is due Cycle 115.
- Bobby Chen-Ramirez (Health Center Project Director): The Cycle 114 statement reports the clinical verification filing, and the tracker schedules the next audit step for Cycle 116; no missed step is shown.
- Keisha Ramos (Baylight Authority Director): Cycle 114 reports workforce coordination completed and evidence-file assembly underway for the Cycle 115 review, without declaring the construction milestone passed.
Open promises she is watching: mayor "Require formal legislative or administrative filings on all four citizen complaints above the visibility threshold, with responsible offices, next action dates, and a public closeout index."; mayor "Publish the C114 placement-gap analysis and a program adjustment plan, explicitly examining West Oakland and Fruitvale without inventing unreported placement results."; council-d7 "Direct the City Auditor and Economic Development staff to execute a formal commercial corridor viability and housing pressure assessment for Rockridge before any municipal intervention is drafted."; transit-hub "Convene the C114 preliminary schematics community review as set by the council: two bilingual sessions (senior center and library), merchant-covenant compliance dossier and Mayer & Associates' community-oversight record published for scrutiny, a written public comment-and-response record, and no assertion of final design or construction approval."; stabilization-fund "Advance charter renewal drafting with the Fund's scope explicitly preserved to West Oakland businesses and residents as chartered, and publish the draft language for review alongside the closeout record."
